consensus_model: Dual-Engine Linear Weighted Consensus with Protocol Invariant Risk Floor

mandatory_invariants.floor_rule: if fsm_violation is True: S_h = max(S_h, 60.0)

quadrant_1_known_normal.input: Conforming HTTP FSM trace + normal ML profile

quadrant_2_statistical_anomaly.input: Conforming HTTP FSM trace + high ML anomaly score (0.85)

quadrant_3_protocol_violation.input: Invalid FSM sequence (auth skipped) + zero ML score (0.0)

quadrant_4_compound_breach.input: Invalid FSM sequence + critical ML score (0.95)

reconciliation_of_75_percent_setting.scope: Frontend UI slider test preference saved to localStorage ('traceguard_hybrid_config')
reconciliation_of_75_percent_setting.academic_notice: Settings explicitly displays Academic Demonstration Scope notice confirming deployed engine uses S_h = 0.6*S_FSM + 0.4*S_ML with 60% floor
